product.title: London Classic Landmarks Bike Tour with Local Guide

description.text: Explore London's rich heritage and fabulous architecture in the open air—on a bicycle. With an experienced guide leading the way, you'll cycle from Covent Garden's vibrant atmosphere to the royal splendor of Buckingham Palace, from Westminster, to the architectural grandeur of St. Paul's Cathedral and beyond. Stops include Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, Covent Garden, St. Paul's Cathedral. Throughout your ride, your guide will share fascinating narratives about the city, covering everything from its moments of triumph to its notorious chapters and all its intrigue in between. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
